app.metaDescription: Merge, convert, extract, delete, reorder, compress, rotate, and visually sign PDFs with optional name and date.

signature.title: Sign a PDF
signature.description: Draw your signature, place it on a page, and export the PDF.

signature.stepFileDescription: Choose the document and page to sign.
signature.stepDrawDescription: Draw in the box, then save it to place it.
signature.detailsDescription: The text will be added to the PDF and can be moved separately.
signature.unsupportedText: The name or date contains a character that this PDF cannot display.
signature.privacy: The signature, name, and date stay in memory during this operation and are not retained after closing.
signature.apiImageTooLarge: The signature image exceeds the 10 MB limit.
signature.ready: Signature ready. Drag it onto the page.
signature.stepPlaceDescription: Move the signature, name, and date separately on the preview. Use the arrow keys to adjust their positions.
signature.previewEmpty: Load a PDF to show its preview.
signature.previewFailed: Could not display this PDF page.
signature.canvasUnavailable: This browser cannot create the preview.
signature.drawFirst: Draw or import a signature before continuing.
signature.canvasExportFailed: Could not save the drawing. Please try again.
signature.outputDescription: PDF with visual signature, name, and date
